$comment: The one file-type registry: Files.Formats and fe-files/icons are built from it; a new type is a row, never code. One row per extension. magic: alternative signatures, each 'offset:hex' parts that must all match; a '~' prefix accepts the signature for a claimed type but never detects it from bytes alone. kind: one of the Files kinds. preview: none, image, video, audio, pdf, text. risk: none, active (forced download), executable.
